title: 第339章 爆元丹
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

方圆上百里的石林中心地带，不时传出一阵巨大的响声。

七八名筑基修士，此刻正施展法术，对着一个巨大的五色护罩狂轰滥炸。

然而这结界却强得惊人，几人轮番轰炸了数个回合，结界也依旧是纹丝不动，丝毫没有破开的迹象。

这让几人的脸色都有些难看起来。

“赵子寒道友，此阵太强了，以我等之力根本无法攻破，我看还是算了吧。”

一名六十来岁样貌的老者，吐了一口闷气后，转头对另一座巨石之上的虬髯老者，满脸无奈地说道。

那位虬髯老者，正是九曲山赵家的三长老，赵子寒。

同时也是这次聚元秘境，赵家队伍的领队之人，不仅修为达到筑基后期，综合战力更是相当强横。

“裴道友，这就放弃了？此阵如此顽强，也侧面说明此地机缘丰厚啊，这般离去，岂不可惜？”

“机缘丰厚有什么用，关键你我两家合力攻了这么久，也根本打不开啊，倒不如趁着还有一个多月的时间，到别处碰碰运气，没准还能有些收获。”

“哎！”

赵子寒叹了一口气，“其实我倒是还有一个办法，就看道友信不信得过我了。”

“什么办法？”裴姓老者眼睛一亮道。

“我这里有几枚‘爆元丹’，吃过之后可以让法术威力膨胀数倍，到时我们两家，再合力一击，没准就能将此阵破开了。”赵子寒微微一笑道。

“爆元丹？赵子寒道友此言当真，为何老夫以前从未听说过这种丹药呢。”裴姓老者惊疑道。

“此丹乃是我赵家从一张古丹方上学来的，即便在赵家，那也是绝密的存在，外面之人没听过也实属正常！所以我才说，就看裴道友信不信得过老夫。”

赵子寒笑着说罢，脸上露出一抹肉疼之色，“说实在的，若非为了凝元草，老夫还真不舍得把此丹拿出来。”

听到此言，裴姓老者顿时有些心动了起来，他凝眉想了下道：“可否让我看看丹药先？”

“自然没问题。”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

In the center of the stone forest, which is hundreds of miles in radius, there are loud noises from time to time.

Seven or eight foundation-building monks were currently casting spells, bombarding a huge five-color shield.

However, this barrier was surprisingly strong. Several people took turns bombing it for several rounds, but the barrier remained motionless and showed no sign of being broken.

This made several people's faces look a little ugly.

"Fellow Daoist Zhao Zihan, this formation is too strong and cannot be broken with our strength. I think we should forget it."

An old man in his sixties, after exhaling a sigh of relief, turned to the old man with a curly beard on another boulder and said helplessly.

The old man with the beard was none other than Zhao Zihan, the third elder of the Zhao family in Jiuqu Mountain.

At the same time, he is also the leader of the Zhao family's team in the Juyuan Secret Realm. Not only has his cultivation reached the late stage of foundation building, but his overall combat power is also quite powerful.

"Fellow Daoist Pei, are you giving up now? This formation is so tenacious, which also shows that this place has rich opportunities. Wouldn't it be a pity to leave like this?"

"What's the use of abundant opportunities? The key is that you and I have been attacking together for so long, but we can't open it at all. It's better to try our luck elsewhere while there is still more than a month. Maybe we can gain something."

"Hey!"

Zhao Zihan sighed, "Actually, I have another way. It depends on whether fellow Taoist believers in me."

"What can we do?" the old man surnamed Pei said with bright eyes.

"I have a few 'Exploding Yuan Pills' here. After eating them, the power of the spell can be increased several times. When the time comes, the two of us can break through this formation with a combined attack." Zhao Zihan said with a slight smile.

"Exploding Yuan Pill? Fellow Taoist Zhao Zihan is serious about what he said. Why have I never heard of this kind of pill before?" The old man surnamed Pei asked in surprise.

"This elixir was learned from an ancient elixir recipe by my Zhao family. Even in the Zhao family, it is a top-secret existence. It is normal for people outside not to have heard of it! That's why I said it depends on whether Fellow Daoist Pei can trust me or not."

Zhao Zihan said with a smile, a look of pain on his face, "To be honest, if it weren't for the Condensing Yuan Grass, I would really be reluctant to take out this elixir."

Hearing this, the old man surnamed Pei suddenly became excited. He frowned and thought for a while and said, "Can you let me see the elixir first?"

"Of course it's no problem."
